description: This file contains helper functions for managing grain storage providers in Orleans, specifically providing a method to retrieve the appropriate IGrainStorage instance based on grain type and service provider, along with error handling.

classes.name: GrainStorageHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to assist with grain storage management.

methods.name: GetGrainStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the IGrainStorage implementation associated with a given grain type by inspecting its attributes and services.

methods.name: ThrowMissingProviderException
methods.description: Throws an exception when no suitable storage provider is found for a grain type.
